'''Jet Venim''' was a [[Nosaurian]] [[racer]] who participated in [[Riot Racing]] on the [[planet]] [[Serolonis]].<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/faster-episode-guide|text="Faster" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> He<ref name="Databank" /> worked under the [[Dowutin]] [[Grini Millegi]]. Venim was a skilled racer who was accustomed to winning. He spoke in [[Nosaurian (language)|Nosaurian]].<ref name="Faster" />
